structuredContent.name: parties.get-party
structuredContent.description: Read an existing party's detail in the envelope tenant. Missing and erased parties return the same safe not-found result; inactive parties remain visible.

PartyId.description: The supplied PartyId, at most 128 characters; tenant comes from the envelope. Use ASCII letters or digits plus '.', '_' or '-'; start and end with an ASCII letter or digit. McpCli refuses legacy braced, parenthesized and X-format GUID IDs before submission, although Parties accepts them.
